## Cloud-Free Conversational AI for Embedded Systems

SiMa.ai Modalix brings conversational AI into embedded Physical AI systems by executing language, 
speech, vision, and retrieval pipelines entirely on-device

, for example, the Google Gemma model.
•  Multimodal conversational AI that sees, listens, and reasons

—running entirely on-device.
•  Real-time speech, vision, and language understanding without cloud dependency.

•  Context-aware, private, and deterministic

—designed for real-world Physical AI systems.
•  Lower system cost and complexity compared to GPU-based edge deployments.

## Google Gemma Powered by SiMa.ai Modalix

## Cloud-Class Multimodal AI with Sub-10W Physical AI Deployment

## Technical Details

Runs Gemma 3 or other LLMs fully 
on-device, compiled with LLiMa for MLA 
acceleration—no cloud or host required.

Integrates Whisper (STT) and 
Piper (TTS) for real-time speech 
recognition and synthesis.

Enables vision-language reasoning 
via CLIP-based image embeddings 
fused into Gemma context.

Executes RAG locally with on-device 
embeddings and similarity 
search—no retraining required.

Achieves ~0.5 s TTFT and over 
13 tokens/sec under a sub-10W 
power envelope.

Utilizes x8 Arm Cortex A65 
APU + MLA + DSP/CVU for concurrent 
multimodal inference.
